changelog: Rewrote [When to Segment] to add concrete negative coherence checks: do not mark a candidate if the preceding text ends with unheaded modifiers (determiners, possessives, adjectives awaiting a noun), with auxiliaries/modals lacking their main verb, with verbs likely to form a phrasal verb whose particle/preposition has not arrived, or with a subordinating introducer that has not completed its clause. This directly addresses placement errors where heads, particles, auxiliaries or possessors arrive after an unsafe split.

Edited [Decision Procedure] step 1 (Marking) to require the generator to enforce the coherence checks above (i.e., a candidate must not leave the preceding text unrenderable by ending in a pre-head modifier, open possessive, auxiliary/modal without main verb, or verb awaiting particle/object). Also clarified ranking signals to penalize boundaries that separate likely noun heads, phrasal-verb particles, clause-final auxiliaries, or possessors. This keeps candidate generation generous but prevents the most damaging premature splits.
